lifestyle.name: Street / Squatter
lifestyle.description: Sleeping in the gutters or an abandoned, unheated building. Healing times are doubled.

lifestyle.name: Low
lifestyle.description: Crappy apartment, soy-paste meals. Matrix connection is spotty (frequent Background Noise penalties).

lifestyle.name: Middle
lifestyle.description: Safe, secure, decent food. Standard existence.

lifestyle.name: High
lifestyle.description: Luxury condo, real meat, clean air. Gain +1 Die on all downtime healing tests.

lifestyle.name: Luxury
lifestyle.description: Penthouse suites, clone banks, private arcology wings. Gain +2 Dice on all downtime healing tests, immune to minor lifestyle inconveniences (Matrix outages, traffic).

lifestyle.name: Coffin Motel (Temporary)
lifestyle.description: A 2x1x1 meter sleeping tube. Secure enough, but induces claustrophobia.

lifestyle.name: The "Null" Zone (Squatter variant)
lifestyle.description: A deliberately offline, EMP-shielded bunker space in the Barrens. Immune to casual Matrix scanning, but provides no Grid access.

lifestyle.name: Family/Dependents (Partner & Kids)
lifestyle.description: A spouse and kids to support. Provides a safehouse and +1 to social tests to gather Hopepunk points. Enemies might leverage them as hostages.

lifestyle.name: Adopted Parent / Mentor
lifestyle.description: You support an elderly or injured mentor. Provides a free, safe place to crash and access to rare knowledge. High risk of them needing medical extraction.

lifestyle.name: Lover / Romantic Connection
lifestyle.description: Regular dinners, gifts, and dates. Provides a dedicated safehouse and a strong connection (Loyalty 4). If the relationship sours, they might leak info.

lifestyle.name: Addiction: BTLs (Better-Than-Life)
lifestyle.description: Escaping the harsh reality of the 6th World. Failing to pay this lifestyle tax causes a -2 penalty to all Mental attributes due to severe withdrawal.

lifestyle.name: Addiction: VR Gaming
lifestyle.description: Gacha mechanics and subscription fees drain your cred. Failing to pay causes a -1 penalty to WIL and INT from distraction and tilt.

lifestyle.name: Addiction: Designer Drugs (Novacoke/Kamikaze)
lifestyle.description: Chasing the chemical dragon. Failing to pay forces a physical withdrawal test (BOD 4) or suffer 3 Stun damage each day.
